_note: PLACEHOLDER — the v0 itemization spine. Two curios drop unidentified and identify at the Storehouse: one into a consumable, one into a key. The key opens a locked cache in a DIFFERENT world than the one it dropped in (design-brief-v0, delayed-payoff seed).
